content: Ari i lmalak di tmesmunt n Sardis! “Ammu i iqqar wenni ɣar iǧa sebɛa n Arruḥat n AREBBI d sebɛa n yetran: ‘Necc ssneɣ řexdayem nnec, aqa ɣarek isem, belli aqa teddared, maca cek aqa tᵉttmettid.
Ḥḍa, sejhed min iqqimen, inni tenwid cek ad ten tᵉttejjid ad tᵉmmtem, maɣar ufiɣ aqa řexdayem nnec war kemmřent ca ɣar AREBBI.
Ɛqeř mliḥ, mammec xas tesřid u mammec tᵉṭṭfed, ḥḍa uca tub! Maca mařa war tᵉttfiqed, ad ɣarek dd-aseɣ am uceffar, war tessined ca di man tasaɛɛet i xak dd ɣa beddeɣ.
Maca ɣari ca n ismawen di Sardis, inni war issxemjen ca arruḍ nsen uca nitni gguren zzati s warruḍ d acemřař, minzi nitni sdaheǧen t.
Wenni i ɣa iɣellben ammu, ad as yarḍen arruḍ d acemřař. Ɛemmarṣ ad kkseɣ isem nnes zeg Wedlis ittwanḍen n Tudart, maca ad cehdeɣ x yisem nnes zzat i Baba d lmalakat nnes.
Wenni ɣar ǧan imezzuɣen, ejj i-t ad iseř min iqqar Arruḥ i tmesmunin.’”

Ari i lmalak n tmesmunt n Filadilfiya! “Ammu i iqqar Umqeddas wenni d Tidett d wenni ɣar iǧa tsarut n Dawud d wenni i ɣa yarezmen, xenni uřa d ijjen ad ibelleɛ, d wenni i ɣa ibellɛen, xenni uřa d ijjen ad yarzem:

‘Necc ssneɣ řexdayem nnec. Xzar, Necc ggiɣ zzatec ict n tewwart tarzem, tenni uřa d ijj war izemmar ad tt ibelleɛ, minzi waxxa jjehd nnec d ameẓyan, qaɛ amenni teḥḍid Awař inu uca war tenkared ca Isem inu.

Xzar, ad wceɣ ca zi temzida n cciṭan, inni iqqaren aqa nitni d Udayen, maca nitni war ǧin ca amenni, maca nitni ssxarriqen. Xzar, ad ten arreɣ ad ac wḍan ɣar iḍaren nnec. Nitni ad neɛmen belli Necc ssɛizzeɣ cek.
Minzi aqa cek teḥḍid Awař inu n ṣṣbar, ad xak ḥḍiɣ ɛawed zi tsaɛɛet n ujarreb tenni i d ɣa yasen x temmurt marra i ujarreb n yinni izeddɣen x temmurt.
Necc ad dd-aseɣ deɣya. Ṭṭef di min ɣarek, ḥima uřa d ijj war d ac ittekkes ca ttaj nnec.

Wenni i ɣa iɣellben ad t ggeɣ d apilar di Zzawect Tameqqrant n AREBBI uca war zzayes ittwammeksi ɛemmarṣ. Necc ad xas ariɣ Isem n AREBBI inu d yisem n tendint n jdid, Urcalim i dd ɣa ihwan zeg ujenna zi AREBBI inu, uřa d Isem inu n jdid.
Wenni ɣar ǧan imezzuɣen, ejj i-t ad iseř min iqqar Arruḥ i tmesmunin.’”
Ari i lmalak n tmesmunt n Layudikiya “Ammu i iqqar wenni d Amin, Acehhad amtiqqi d tidett, wenni d beddu n marra min dd-ixřeq AREBBI:
‘Necc ssneɣ řexdayem nnec, aqa cek war tesmiḍed war teḥmid. Meɛlik beɛda tsemḍed niɣ teḥmid!
S uyenni, umi cek temřuded, war teḥmid, war tesmiḍed, ad cek ɛuqqeɣ zeg uqemmum inu.
Minzi cek teqqared: Necc ɣari agřa uca immarni-dd ɣari wagřa, war d ayi ittxeṣṣi walu, am war tessined ca belli aqa cek tḥeřced u dayek řeɣben d zzeřḍ u aqa cek d adarɣař d aɛaryan,

ad cek neṣḥeɣ maḥend ad xafi tesɣed wureɣ iqquren, ikkin timessi, ḥima ad tdewřed d bu-wagřa, uřa d arruḍ d acemřař, ḥima ad t tyarḍed u war teqqim tḍehhar ɛad řefḍiḥet n tuɛɛaryent nnec. U dhen ɛawed ddhen x tiṭṭawin nnec maḥend ad taf tettwařid.
Marra wenni ssɛizzeɣ, ttwebbxeɣ t u arebbiɣ t. Xenni cḍar, tub!
Aqa da, Necc beddeɣ ɣar tewwart, ssqarqubeɣ-dd. Mařa isřa ḥed i tmijja inu, ad yarzem tawwart, Necc ad ɣares adfeɣ uca ad kis mmunesweɣ d netta akidi.
Wenni i ɣa iɣellben ad as wceɣ, ḥima ad iqqim akidi x řɛarc inu, am Necc ɣellbeɣ uca qqimeɣ ak-d Baba x řɛarc nnes.
Wenni ɣar ǧan imezzuɣen, ejj i-t ad iseř min iqqar Arruḥ i tmesmunin.’” *
